lesson.title: Expressing Wants and Intentions
lesson.subtitle: Topic-based beginner conversation lesson
lesson.description: Practice use 想 and 要 for wants and intentions. Transcript-referenced conversational Mandarin study organized by communicative goal rather than audio track.

learning_objectives: Use 想 and 要 for wants and intentions.

blocks.text: Topic lesson based on Conversational Mandarin, tracks 1–16. Dialogue is an editorial teaching exchange using source-attested expressions; it is not presented as a verbatim audio transcript.

turns.speaker: A
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī yìdiǎn dōngxi ma?
turns.english: Would you like something to eat?

turns.speaker: B
turns.english: I do not want to eat.

turns.speaker: A
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng hē yìdiǎn chá ma?

turns.speaker: B
turns.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ xiǎng hē yìdiǎn chá.
turns.english: Yes, I would like a little tea.

blocks.function_en: 想 (xiǎng) expresses a wish or desire followed by a verb.

example.teaching_note: Use this construction in your own dialogue.

blocks.function_en: An A-not-A question asks whether someone wants to do something.

example.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng hē chá?
example.english: Do you want to drink tea?
example.teaching_note: Use this construction in your own dialogue.

items.meaning_en: I would like to; I want to.
You would like to; you want to.
I would like something to drink.
What do you want to buy?
I would like a little tea.

items.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng chī yìdiǎn dōngxi ma
items.meaning_en: Would you like something to eat?
I would like something to eat.
I do not want to eat now.
I would like to drink now.
I intend to have lunch now.
I do not want to eat.
When would you like to eat?

blocks.text: Speaking task: Offer food and drink, accept one offer and politely decline another.

questions.prompt: In the model conversation, what does speaker B say in the first reply?
questions.answer: 我不想吃。 (Wǒ bù xiǎng chī.) — I do not want to eat.
questions.explanation: Read the first two turns again, then answer without looking.

questions.prompt: Translate into Mandarin: I want to eat.
questions.explanation: One model answer; another natural equivalent may be acceptable.

questions.prompt: Make a sentence using the pattern 想不想…… (xiǎng bu xiǎng).
questions.answer: 你想不想喝茶？ (nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng hē chá?) — Do you want to drink tea?
questions.explanation: Use the word order shown in the second grammar explanation.

questions.prompt: Offer food and drink, accept one offer and politely decline another.
questions.answer: 你想吃一点东西吗？ (Nǐ xiǎng chī yìdiǎn dōngxi ma?) — 我不想吃。 (Wǒ bù xiǎng chī.)
questions.explanation: Sample opening exchange. Continue the role-play in your own words.
